name: Branching Quests
description: Two questlines with real choices and multiple endings. THE SECRET MAP: a sailor gives you a map two people want - side with the Saffron scientist (rare TM) or the Fuchsia gambler (gold), and each ending locks out the other while both NPCs react to your choice. THE POACHER'S BARGAIN: a researcher sends you after a poacher - recover the amber shard for a reward, or take the poacher's bribe and let him go. Custom key items, MOD_ flags, and consequence dialogue. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
